import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. The placeholders {title} and {body} # will be replaced by the sanitized heading and description respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML‑formatted string ready to be embedded in a web page. Notes ----- - The function uses `html.escape` to neutralise any HTML special characters in the user input, preventing injection attacks (CWE‑74). - The function does not alter line breaks or formatting beyond escaping, allowing the caller to preserve intended paragraph breaks via `
` tags or Markdown processing if desired. """ # Sanitize inputs to prevent HTML injection safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML by inserting sanitized values return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description)
